---
Title: Examining Type I Error based on Sim Data
---

## Setup
```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(furrr)
library(glue)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(rms)
library(VGAM)
```

## Load data

- underlying truths: 
- first order markov
- time follows third order polynomial
- treatment effect on y = 0
- yprev interacts fully with time

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

# Load full dataset
# If we reasign the treatment again and again, emergency room visits are a bit too rare and mess up transitions
# We therefore collapse staet 3 and 4
df_full <- read_parquet(here("2-hosp", "sim-data", "sim_data_po_const.parquet")) |> 
    # mutate(
    #     y = as.numeric(as.character(y)),
    #     y = if_else(y == 4, 3, y),
    #     y = if_else(y == 5, 4, y),
    #     yprev = if_else(yprev == "4", "3", yprev),
    #     yprev = factor(yprev)) |> 
    filter(tx == "0") |> 
    select(id, tx, y, yprev, time)


# df without yprev x time interaction
df_full_no_int <- read_parquet(here("2-hosp", "sim-data", "sim_data_vglm.parquet")) |> 
    # mutate(
    #     y = as.numeric(as.character(y)),
    #     y = if_else(y == 4, 3, y),
    #     y = if_else(y == 5, 4, y),
    #     yprev = if_else(yprev == "4", "3", yprev),
    #     yprev = factor(yprev)) |> 
    select(id, tx, y, yprev, time)
```

## Simulation function

```{r}
run_simulation_iteration <- function(iter_num, base_path, full_data, model_formula, cumulative_arg, seed = 123, sample_size = 270) {
    # This function runs one full simulation iteration.
    
    # --- 1. Setup for the current iteration ---
    set.seed(seed + iter_num)


    tx_ids <- full_data |> 
        distinct(id) |> 
        pull(id) |> sample(round(0.5* sample_size), replace = FALSE)

    soc_ids <- full_data |> 
        distinct(id) |> 
        pull(id) |> 
        setdiff(tx_ids) |> 
        sample(round(0.5* sample_size), replace = FALSE)

    data_for_model <- full_data |> 
        filter(id %in% c(tx_ids, soc_ids)) |>
        mutate(
            tx = if_else(id %in% tx_ids, "1", "0"),
            tx = factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1)))
    
    rm(full_data)
    
    if (nrow(data_for_model) > 0) {
        model <- tryCatch({ 
            vglm(
                model_formula,
                cumulative_arg,
                data = data_for_model)
            
        }, error = function(e) {
            message(glue("ERROR in iteration {iter_num}: {e$message}"))
            
            saveRDS(data_for_model, file.path(iter_path, "problematic_data.rds"))
            
            return(NULL)
        })
        
        # --- 7. Save the results ONLY if the model ran successfully ---
        if (!is.null(model)) {
            summary_df <- summary(model)@coef3 |> data.frame() |> 
                rownames_to_column("term")

            return(summary_df)
        }
    }
    return(NULL)
}
```

## Type I Error for data w/ interaction
```{r}
N_SIMULATIONS <- 1500
OUTPUT_PATH <- here("2-hosp", "output", "sim-simdata-H0-freq")
RESULTS_FILE <- "sim-simdata-H0.parquet"
N_CORES <- 8

# define model specs
main_formula <- ordered(y) ~ tx + poly(time, 3) * yprev
cumulative_formula <- cumulative(reverse = TRUE, parallel = FALSE ~ poly(time, 3))

t1 <- Sys.time()

message(glue("Starting {N_SIMULATIONS} new simulations on {N_CORES} cores..."))

future::plan(future.callr::callr, workers = N_CORES)

# --- Run Simulations in Parallel ---
results <- furrr::future_map_dfr(
    .x = 1:N_SIMULATIONS,
    .f = ~ run_simulation_iteration(
        iter_num = .x,
        full_data = df_full,
        model_formula = main_formula,
        cumulative_arg = cumulative_formula,
    ),
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
    .progress = TRUE,
    .id = "iter" # Automatically adds an iteration column
)

write_parquet(results, here(OUTPUT_PATH, RESULTS_FILE))

message(glue("Finished {N_SIMULATIONS} simulations."))

t2 <- Sys.time()

message("Simulation process finished.")
t2-t1
```


```{r}
# Read and stack all draw files into a single data frame
results <- read_parquet(here(OUTPUT_PATH, RESULTS_FILE))

p_values <- results |> filter(term == "tx1") |> 
    pull(`Pr...z..`)

hist(p_values, breaks = 100)

mean(p_values < 0.05)

tibble(
    p_value = p_values,
    significant = p_values < 0.05
) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = p_value)) +
    ggdist::geom_dots()
```

## Type I Error for data w/o interaction
```{r}
N_SIMULATIONS <- 1000
OUTPUT_PATH <- here("2-hosp", "output", "sim-simdata-H0-freq")
RESULTS_FILE <- "sim-simdata-H0-no-int.parquet"
N_CORES <- 8

# define model specs
main_formula <- ordered(y) ~ tx + poly(time, 3) + yprev
cumulative_formula <- cumulative(reverse = TRUE, parallel = FALSE ~ poly(time, 3))

t1 <- Sys.time()

message(glue("Starting {N_SIMULATIONS} new simulations on {N_CORES} cores..."))

future::plan(future.callr::callr, workers = N_CORES)

# --- Run Simulations in Parallel ---
results <- furrr::future_map_dfr(
    .x = 1:N_SIMULATIONS,
    .f = ~ run_simulation_iteration(
        iter_num = .x,
        full_data = df_full_no_int,
        model_formula = main_formula,
        cumulative_arg = cumulative_formula,
        sample_size = 1000,
        seed = 888
    ),
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
    .progress = TRUE,
    .id = "iter" # Automatically adds an iteration column
)

write_parquet(results, here(OUTPUT_PATH, RESULTS_FILE))

message(glue("Finished {N_SIMULATIONS} simulations."))

t2 <- Sys.time()

message("Simulation process finished.")
t2-t1
```

## Type I Error for data generated from VGLM fit

```{r}
vm2 <- vglm(
  ordered(y) ~ tx + poly(time, 3) + yprev,
  cumulative(reverse = TRUE, parallel = FALSE ~ poly(time, 3)),
  data = df_full_no_int
  )

coef(vm2)

```
